class.name: JoltPhysicsServer3D
class.description: The Jolt Physics server, reachable through this singleton when [member ProjectSettings.physics/3d/physics_engine] is [code]"Jolt Physics"[/code]. The [PhysicsServer3D] singleton is a thread-safety wrapper that only forwards the common API, so the Jolt-only joint settings below are reached here, on the same joint [RID]s ([method Joint3D.get_rid], [method PhysicalBone3D.get_joint_rid]). [b]Note:[/b] These methods call the server directly. With [member ProjectSettings.physics/3d/run_on_separate_thread] enabled, only call them while the physics thread is not stepping. [b]Note:[/b] Settings made here are not stored on the joint nodes. Anything that rebuilds a node's joint (for example changing a [PhysicalBone3D] joint property) creates a new joint without them.

method.name: joint_get_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the joint is enabled.

method.name: joint_get_solver_position_iterations
method.description: Returns the position iteration override of the joint, or [code]0[/code] if it uses [member ProjectSettings.physics/jolt_physics_3d/simulation/position_steps].

method.name: joint_get_solver_velocity_iterations
method.description: Returns the velocity iteration override of the joint, or [code]0[/code] if it uses [member ProjectSettings.physics/jolt_physics_3d/simulation/velocity_steps].

method.name: joint_set_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables the joint. A disabled joint stays in the space but applies no constraint.

method.name: joint_set_solver_position_iterations
method.description: Overrides the number of position iterations for the island that contains this joint. Jolt uses the largest override among the island's constraints. [code]0[/code] restores [member ProjectSettings.physics/jolt_physics_3d/simulation/position_steps].

method.name: joint_set_solver_velocity_iterations
method.description: Overrides the number of velocity iterations for the island that contains this joint. Jolt uses the largest override among the island's constraints. [code]0[/code] restores [member ProjectSettings.physics/jolt_physics_3d/simulation/velocity_steps].

Frequency of the linear spring, in Hz, used instead of its stiffness when [constant G6DOF_JOINT_FLAG_ENABLE_LINEAR_SPRING_FREQUENCY] is enabled.
Frequency of the soft linear limit spring, in Hz, used when [constant G6DOF_JOINT_FLAG_ENABLE_LINEAR_LIMIT_SPRING] is enabled.

Frequency of the angular spring, in Hz, used instead of its stiffness when [constant G6DOF_JOINT_FLAG_ENABLE_ANGULAR_SPRING_FREQUENCY] is enabled.
Makes the linear limits soft, with the spring set by [constant G6DOF_JOINT_LINEAR_LIMIT_SPRING_FREQUENCY] and [constant G6DOF_JOINT_LINEAR_LIMIT_SPRING_DAMPING].

Drives the linear spring by frequency and damping ratio ([constant G6DOF_JOINT_LINEAR_SPRING_FREQUENCY], [constant PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_LINEAR_SPRING_DAMPING]) instead of stiffness and damping. Takes precedence over [constant G6DOF_JOINT_FLAG_ENABLE_LINEAR_SPRING_MASS_NORMALIZED].

Drives the angular spring by frequency and damping ratio ([constant G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_SPRING_FREQUENCY], [constant PhysicsServer3D.G6DOF_JOINT_ANGULAR_SPRING_DAMPING]) instead of stiffness and damping. Takes precedence over [constant G6DOF_JOINT_FLAG_ENABLE_ANGULAR_SPRING_MASS_NORMALIZED].

Interprets the linear spring's stiffness and damping as divided by the effective mass, in 1/s² and 1/s (Jolt's [code]MassNormalizedStiffnessAndDamping[/code] mode), so the same values give the same response on bodies of any mass. Ignored while [constant G6DOF_JOINT_FLAG_ENABLE_LINEAR_SPRING_FREQUENCY] is enabled.

Interprets the angular spring's stiffness and damping as divided by the effective inertia, in 1/s² and 1/s (Jolt's [code]MassNormalizedStiffnessAndDamping[/code] mode), so the same values give the same response on bodies of any inertia. Ignored while [constant G6DOF_JOINT_FLAG_ENABLE_ANGULAR_SPRING_FREQUENCY] is enabled.
